encounter.text: A rusted cage hangs from the low ceiling by a chain, swinging slightly. Inside, a weasel in a very fine but very ruined waistcoat is pressed against the bars. 'You — you're not Brackenfang,' it says, voice dropping to a hiss. 'Listen. I was caught lifting from the wrong cache. They'll be back. Get me out of this and I'll make it worth your while. I have coin hidden. A lot of it.'

choices.text: Pick the lock and free them.
Tell them you'll inform the ratlings — for a cut.

freed.text: The lock takes a moment but gives. The weasel drops down, straightens their ruined waistcoat with tremendous dignity, and leads you to a loose stone in the far wall. Behind it: a cloth bag, coins inside. 'As promised. Now I'd like to leave quickly and never speak of this.'

choices.text: Take your cut and let them go.

betrayed.text: The weasel's eyes go flat. There's a crack and a snap — they've been working the cage lock from inside the whole time. The door swings open. 'I was going to give you a third,' they say, dropping to the ground. 'Now you get nothing but the lesson.'

items.name: Lockpick Shiv
items.description: A modified lockpick, surprisingly effective as a blade.
